parameters.query:
with ins as (
  insert into attack_events (event_key, source, event_at, kind, signature, category, severity,
                             outbreak_id, outbreak_tags, src_country, src_city, src_lat, src_lon,
                             dst_country, dst_city, dst_lat, dst_lon, hits, raw)
  select md5(r.raw::text), 'fortinet', to_timestamp(r.event_ms / 1000.0), r.kind, r.signature,
         r.category, r.severity, r.outbreak_id, r.outbreak_tags, r.src_country, r.src_city,
         r.src_lat, r.src_lon, r.dst_country, r.dst_city, r.dst_lat, r.dst_lon,
         coalesce(r.hits, 1), r.raw
  from jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) as r(event_ms bigint, kind text, signature text, category text,
       severity text, outbreak_id text, outbreak_tags text[], src_country text, src_city text,
       src_lat double precision, src_lon double precision, dst_country text, dst_city text,
       dst_lat double precision, dst_lon double precision, hits integer, raw jsonb)
  on conflict (event_key) do nothing
  returning 1
)
select count(*) as inserted from ins

parameters.content:
## Threat map: Fortinet attack events

Every minute, pulls the last 90 s of FortiGuard's public outbreak threat-map feed (the data behind fortiguard.fortinet.com/threat-map) into `attack_events`.

- Events carry city-level source/destination geo and the IPS/AV signature, **no IPs**.
- Polls overlap by 30 s; `event_key` (md5 of the raw event) drops repeats.
- Undocumented endpoint: if it changes shape, *To rows* outputs nothing and the run still succeeds. Watch `ingest_health`.
